killedBy: hud: the pause exit is contextual (issue #323) names the destination at Pause wherever one can be named, and keeps the generic word where it cannot
why: Puts the generic word back on a paused versus match. Issue #261's contract is "do not expose a generic Quit action when a specific destination can be named", and here one can: a versus match shares the campaign run store but writes nothing to it, so `Quit to Title` described a cost that is not being paid -- on the one surface where the player is asking what leaving costs. The campaign and null-status arms are untouched, which is what makes the label a disagreement this panel can express rather than a constant.
